global_rules.rule: All steps in this SOP must be performed using only the following tools. Do not reference or rely on any software, service, or data source other than those listed below unless this document is formally amended.

Source data (reports, exports, clearing confirmations, policy PDFs, claim packets, etc.) is assumed to arrive as attachments on the Jira issues or Email threads cited in each procedure, or as files you save to Excel/Word from those attachments.
If an expected attachment is missing, follow the exception path (typically Jira escalation) for that section.
If you lack access to any required tool, create a Jira ticket in the IT-Support queue immediately.

All output files produced under this SOP must follow the naming pattern stated in the procedure that creates them. Where a procedure does not specify a file name, use the default convention: [Deliverable Type]_[Identifier]_[Date YYYY-MM-DD].[ext]. Do not use spaces in file names; use underscores.
All external emails must be sent from an authorized @vanguardshield.com account.

This SOP establishes standardized operational procedures for designated staff within Vanguard Shield Mutual. It is intended for trained personnel with approved access and required confidentiality, security, and role-based training. This document does not replace legal, regulatory, compliance, or company policy requirements. If this SOP conflicts with applicable law, regulation, contractual obligation, or company policy, the stricter requirement governs.

escalation.name: Exception Escalation Paths
steps: If an expected attachment is missing, follow the exception path (typically Jira escalation) for that section.
For intercompany suspense items without PDF receipt or Slack approval, escalate via Jira FIN-Exceptions using Template B-1.
For international wire control exceptions lacking dual Slack approval, escalate via Jira ComplianceAlerts queue using Template B-3, then post Slack pointer using Template B-4 in #compliance-urgent.
For unsupported expense variances, escalate via Jira FIN-Exceptions using Template B-6.
For missing billing contact on AR collections, post Slack message using Template B-5 in #ar-collections.
For T&E manager lookup failures, escalate via Jira HR-Ops or Email to hrops@vanguardshield.com using Template B-8.
must_not: Do not include dollar amounts, beneficiary bank data, or full wire instructions in Slack compliance pointer (Template B-4).
Do not include full account numbers in email body text (Template A-2).

definitions.FIN-100: Cleared & Posted — reconciliations complete; outcome documented on Jira
definitions.FIN-201: Vendor AP Hold — missing W-9 PDF or failed banking verification
definitions.TRE-900: High-Risk Exception — wire lacks dual Slack approval evidence
definitions.UND-304: Audit Variance — audited premium materially differs from estimated basis
definitions.CLM-440: Subro Potential — closed paid claim triage; police report indicates third-party fault language
definitions.CLM-999: SIU Hold — duplicate photos or inspector inconsistency notes
definitions.CLM-910: Identity Verification Hold — death certificate mismatch vs insured record
definitions.CLM-920: Complex Beneficiary Hold — legal/beneficiary conflict documentation present

procedures.name: Reconciling Intercompany Suspense
procedures.applies_when: Clearing and documenting Intercompany Suspense activity by the 5th business day of each month.

inputs.source: PDF attachment on Jira sub-task or linked issue

decisions.rule: Amount > $5,000
decisions.then: Verify approval evidence in Slack and locate receipts from Jira

decisions.rule: GL code on PDF invoice disagrees with GL code in Excel line description
decisions.then: Record both codes, mark Conflict? as Y, comment on Jira sub-task, and follow Exception handling

decisions.rule: PDF missing from Jira, Slack approval not found (for items > $5,000), GL coding cannot be determined, or GL codes conflict
decisions.then: Create Jira ticket in FIN-Exceptions queue with Template B-1 and assign to Finance Controller
decisions.else: Complete reclassification and document in Jira

steps: Generate workbook: On Jira issue OPS-FIN-SUSPENSE-[YYYY-MM] (month-close package), download the suspense workbook attachment (Excel) and save a local working copy with a clear month identifier (§1.4).
Filter discrepancies: In Excel, filter the Amount column into (a) items exceeding $5,000 and (b) items less than or equal to $5,000.

Clear items ≤ $5,000: For each line, (a) open the linked Jira sub-task or the PDF attachment on the month-close issue whose name or description matches the transaction ID and amount; (b) confirm GL coding from the invoice text and the line description in Excel; (c) document the tie-out in your local suspense workbook (add the following columns if not already present: Support Found (Y/N) and Support Location / Invoice); (d) if support is found, record the reclassification in Jira: comment on the line's sub-task with transaction ID, target GL, and status FIN-100 Cleared & Posted.

Conflicting GL codes: If the GL code on the PDF invoice disagrees with the GL code in the Excel line description, do not resolve the conflict yourself. Record both codes in your local suspense workbook tie-out columns (add a column 'Conflict?' marked Y). Create a comment on the Jira sub-task: 'GL conflict: Invoice shows [code A], Excel line shows [code B] — requesting Controller clarification.' Then follow the Exception handling step.
Verify approval evidence (items > $5,000 only): In Slack, open finance-approvals. Search: has:link [Exact Dollar Amount] to locate the manager approval message.
Locate receipts: From Jira, open the PDF invoice attached to the matching sub-task or linked issue for that transaction ID.

Prepare reclassification (items > $5,000 only): In Jira, on the suspense line sub-task, add a comment documenting the GL code from the PDF and transition or label the work per team convention to FIN-100 Cleared & Posted after approval.

Exception handling: If the PDF is missing from Jira, Slack approval cannot be found (for items > $5,000), GL coding cannot be determined, or GL codes conflict between sources, create a Jira ticket in the FIN-Exceptions queue. Paste Template B-1 into the description and assign to the Finance Controller listed on the FIN-Exceptions board's pinned issue (see §1.3 Queue Assignee). In comments, note the Jira issue keys and Slack search you used and what evidence was not found or conflicted.
deadlines: Clear and properly document Intercompany Suspense activity by the 5th business day of each month.
must_not: Do not resolve GL code conflicts yourself; record both codes and escalate to Controller.

procedures.name: Performing Expense Variance Analysis
procedures.applies_when: Monitoring departmental spending against approved quarterly budgets to identify material variances requiring explanation.

inputs.source: Excel export attached to Jira issue OPS-FIN-BVA-[Department]-[Quarter]
Department Head custom field on the OPS-FIN-BVA Jira issue (see §1.3)
Shared mailbox finance.ops@vanguardshield.com, searched using over-budget line item name and variants across prior 90 days

decisions.rule: Variance % > 10%
decisions.then: Investigate cause
decisions.else: No further action required for that line item

decisions.rule: Justification email found in mailbox search
decisions.then: Complete Memo Template D-1 with supporting details, attach to original OPS-FIN-BVA Jira issue, mark variance as Supported; do not escalate to FIN-Exceptions
decisions.else: State that no supporting justification was found, document search terms and date range, and escalate to FIN-Exceptions

steps: From Jira issue OPS-FIN-BVA-[Department]-[Quarter], download the budget-vs-actual export attached to the issue (Excel as provided).

In Excel, add a column for percentage variance using formula: =IF(B2=0,IF(C2>0,9999,0),(C2-B2)/B2) formatted as Percentage, where Budget is in column B and Actual is in column C. Interpret 9999% as actual spend with a $0 budget requiring review.
Filter Variance % column to show values greater than 10%.

For each over-budget line item, open shared mailbox finance.ops@vanguardshield.com in Email. Search using the over-budget line item name and variants (vendor, project, cost center) across at least the prior 90 days. Capture search terms used and whether results were found.

In Word, paste Memo Template D-1. Complete fields from the Budget vs. Actual workbook and any supporting emails. For Department Head Name field, read the 'Department Head' custom field on the OPS-FIN-BVA issue (see §1.3).
If no justification email exists, do not infer a reason; state that no supporting justification was found, document search terms and date range, and proceed to escalation.

If a justification email is found, complete Memo Template D-1 with the supporting details, attach the finished memo to the original OPS-FIN-BVA Jira issue, and mark the variance as Supported; do not escalate to FIN-Exceptions.

For unsupported variance: Create a Jira ticket in FIN-Exceptions titled 'Unsupported Expense Variance – [Department] – Q[Number] – [Line Item]'. Attach the drafted Memo D-1 and the budget-vs-actual export. Paste Template B-6 into the description. Also include: (a) line item name, (b) budget, actual, variance %, (c) mailbox searched, (d) exact search terms and date range, (e) Controller disposition request. Assign to the Finance Controller per §1.3 Queue Assignee.

Save the Word memo per §1.4 (include department and quarter in the filename). Attach it to the same Jira issue (or FIN-Exceptions ticket). If applicable, put the Jira key in the file name or memo header.
must_not: Do not infer a reason if no justification email exists; state that no supporting justification was found.
Do not escalate to FIN-Exceptions if a justification email is found and variance is marked as Supported.
notes: 9999% variance indicates actual spend with a $0 budget and must be reviewed.

procedures.name: Verifying Fixed Asset Depreciation
procedures.applies_when: Qualifying asset purchases must be capitalized and depreciated in accordance with company policy.

inputs.fact: General expense ledger transactions with amounts ≥ $10,000
inputs.source: Jira OPS-FIN-FA-[period] general expense ledger attachment (Excel) / Transaction Amount column

inputs.fact: Fixed asset subledger data for cross-referencing
Depreciation method and life per asset class
inputs.source: Vanguard Depreciation Matrix: IT Equipment = 3 years straight-line; Furniture = 7 years MACRS; Software = 5 years straight-line

decisions.rule: Transaction Amount ≥ $10,000
decisions.then: Proceed to check capitalization status

decisions.rule: Transaction ID cross-referenced against fixed-asset subledger
decisions.then: If marked as Fixed Asset, verify depreciation method; if missing, evaluate for capitalization

decisions.rule: Asset Class is in Vanguard Depreciation Matrix but life/method is wrong
decisions.then: Create or update Jira ticket in FIN-FA-Review requesting change citing matrix line; attach Excel excerpt and any PDF invoice from Jira; assign to Senior Accountant listed on FIN-FA-Review board's pinned issue per §1.3
decisions.else: If Asset Class is not in matrix, create or update Jira ticket in FIN-FA-Review requesting review with proposed life blank or TBD — Policy Needed; assign to same Senior Accountant

decisions.rule: Item > $10,000 missing from subledger and qualifies as fixed asset (tangible or qualifying software, useful life > 12 months, company ownership/control, threshold met and not excluded: training, support, professional services)
decisions.then: Create Jira OPS-FIN-JE draft with comment listing invoice/PO, vendor, description, proposed asset class; assign to Senior Accountant
decisions.else: If clearly not qualifying, document conclusion in Excel notes and continue; if unclear, Jira comment to Senior Accountant: 'Capitalization eligibility unclear — policy confirmation needed'

steps: From Jira OPS-FIN-FA-[period], download the general expense ledger attachment (Excel). Filter Transaction Amount for values ≥ $10,000.
Cross-reference transaction IDs against the fixed-asset subledger attachment (Excel) from the same Jira package.
For rows marked as Fixed Asset, compare Asset Class to the Vanguard Depreciation Matrix: IT Equipment = 3 years straight-line; Furniture = 7 years MACRS; Software = 5 years straight-line.

If method is wrong or asset class missing from matrix: Do not edit source ledgers yourself. Create or update a Jira ticket in FIN-FA-Review: (a) if class is in the matrix but life/method is wrong, request change citing matrix line; attach Excel excerpt and any PDF invoice from Jira; assign to the Senior Accountant listed on the FIN-FA-Review board's pinned issue per §1.3. (b) If class is not in the matrix, request review with proposed life blank or TBD — Policy Needed; assign to the same Senior Accountant.

For items > $10,000 missing from the subledger, do not capitalize on dollar value alone. Confirm qualification using invoice/PO text in Jira PDF attachments: nature (tangible or qualifying software, not routine services), useful life > 12 months, company ownership/control, threshold met and not excluded (training, support, professional services). Qualifying examples: computers, servers, vehicles, furniture, machinery, licensed perpetual/multi-year software. Nonqualifying examples: consulting fees, temporary labor, consumable supplies, monthly maintenance agreements, annual SaaS subscriptions without a perpetual license.
If qualified, create Jira OPS-FIN-JE draft with comment listing invoice/PO, vendor, description, proposed asset class; assign to the Senior Accountant.
If clearly not qualifying, document conclusion in Excel notes and continue.
If unclear, Jira comment to the Senior Accountant: 'Capitalization eligibility unclear — policy confirmation needed.'
must_not: Do not edit source ledgers yourself.
Do not capitalize on dollar value alone.

links.when: When assigning Jira tickets to Senior Accountant per §1.3

procedures.name: Managing Daily Cash Liquidity
procedures.applies_when: Daily review of Vanguard Shield's liquid cash position to ensure it meets the $15,000,000 threshold.

inputs.fact: Reporting date and daily liquid position attachment (PDF or Excel)

inputs.source: TRE-Exceptions board's pinned issue per §1.3 Queue Assignee

decisions.rule: Attachment is missing, mis-dated, or unreadable
decisions.then: Comment 'Data package incomplete — cannot certify liquidity review' and create or reopen Jira OPS-FIN-DATA-[date] per routing note in OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY description. Do not estimate a balance from prior days.

decisions.rule: Current Liquid Balance ≥ $15,000,000
decisions.then: Comment 'No liquidity transfer required — meets threshold' and stop for that day.

decisions.rule: Open Jira TRE-Investments issue titled 'Daily Liquidity Transfer – [same calendar date]' exists in Awaiting Treasury Director Approval with the same calculated amount
decisions.then: Comment 'Duplicate liquidity request detected — see [KEY]' instead of creating a second ticket.
decisions.else: If an open ticket exists with a different amount, comment 'Amount superseded — recalculated to $[new]' with brief rationale, then proceed to route for approval.

decisions.rule: TRE-Investments issue is rejected or remains in Awaiting Treasury Director Approval for more than one full business day after submission
decisions.then: Comment on OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY-[date] with the blocking TRE-Investments key and create Jira TRE-Exceptions titled 'Liquidity Transfer Blocked – [Date]'; assign per Treasury escalation roster in OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY issue description. If roster is blank or missing, look up assignee on TRE-Exceptions board's pinned issue per §1.3 Queue Assignee.

steps: By 8:30 AM ET, open Jira OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY-[YYYY-MMDD] and confirm the issue description states the reporting date and that the daily liquid position attachment (PDF or Excel) is present for that date.

If attachment is missing, mis-dated, or unreadable, comment 'Data package incomplete — cannot certify liquidity review' and create or reopen Jira OPS-FIN-DATA-[date] per routing note in OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY description. Do not estimate a balance from prior days.
Download the liquid position attachment and capture Current Liquid Balance.
Add a Jira comment on OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY with: (a) time of review (ET), (b) balance, (c) attachment name/version used, (d) your initials.
If Current Liquid Balance ≥ $15,000,000, comment 'No liquidity transfer required — meets threshold' and stop for that day.

If below $15,000,000, compute TransferAmount = $15,000,000 − Current Liquid Balance. Follow rounding rules stated on OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY (if none, round to the nearest $1,000). Record the arithmetic (balance read, subtraction, and rounded result).

Search Jira project TRE-Investments for open issues titled 'Daily Liquidity Transfer – [same calendar date]'. If one exists in Awaiting Treasury Director Approval with the same calculated amount, comment 'Duplicate liquidity request detected — see [KEY]' instead of creating a second ticket. If an open ticket exists with a different amount, comment 'Amount superseded — recalculated to $[new]' with brief rationale before proceeding.

Create or update Jira TRE-Investments issue titled 'Daily Liquidity Transfer – [Date]'. Paste Template B-7 into the description, then add the arithmetic recorded above. Set status to Awaiting Treasury Director Approval.

If the TRE-Investments issue is rejected or remains in Awaiting Treasury Director Approval for more than one full business day after submission, comment on OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY-[date] with the blocking TRE-Investments key and create Jira TRE-Exceptions titled 'Liquidity Transfer Blocked – [Date]'; assign per Treasury escalation roster in OPS-TRE-LIQUIDITY issue description. If roster is blank or missing, look up assignee on TRE-Exceptions board's pinned issue per §1.3 Queue Assignee.
deadlines: Review must start by 8:30 AM ET.
Escalate if TRE-Investments issue is not approved within one full business day after submission.
must_not: Do not estimate a balance from prior days if attachment is missing, mis-dated, or unreadable.
Do not create a second TRE-Investments ticket if a duplicate with the same amount exists in Awaiting Treasury Director Approval.
notes: Priority: Ensure liquidity threshold is met daily to cover outflows.

links.when: When creating or updating TRE-Investments issue, paste Template B-7 into description.
If TRE-Investments issue is rejected or stale, create TRE-Exceptions ticket and assign per escalation roster.

procedures.name: Resolving Vendor Payment Discrepancies
procedures.applies_when: Vendor reports nonreceipt of payment.

inputs.source: Jira issue OPS-AP-INV-[InvoiceNumber] description or custom fields
Jira issue OPS-AP-INV-[InvoiceNumber] description or custom fields
Jira OPS-APTRACE-[TraceNumber] or trace attachment on OPS-AP-INV-[InvoiceNumber]

decisions.rule: Payment Status is Paid
decisions.then: Copy the 12-digit ACH trace number and proceed to Trace funds
decisions.else: Check if status is failed/rejected or not Paid

decisions.rule: Payment Status is failed/rejected
decisions.then: Set Jira label or comment FIN-201 Vendor AP Hold and send Template A-2
decisions.else: Status is not Paid (Pending, Processing, Approved-Unpaid, Under Review)

decisions.rule: Status is not Paid (Pending, Processing, Approved-Unpaid, Under Review)
decisions.then: Do not request a trace yet. Capture status and payment run/date from the Jira description and record them in a Jira comment. Email the vendor using Template A-4 without attaching a clearing confirmation. If the vendor disputes urgency or invoice is past due, Email the AP Lead listed on the AP queue board's pinned issue per §1.3.

decisions.rule: Trace result PDF shows Cleared / successful (status text or code indicates completion, e.g., Posted, Completed, Settled, Success, ACK, or equivalent, and does not show a return or reject code)
decisions.then: Download the clearing confirmation PDF from Jira OPS-AP-INV-[InvoiceNumber] first (primary location). If not there, download from OPS-AP-TRACE[TraceNumber]. If neither issue contains the file, comment 'Clearing confirmation missing' on OPS-AP-INV and follow the AP queue's exception path — do not send Template A-1 until the PDF is attached. Email the vendor Template A-1 attaching the PDF.
decisions.else: Check if Rejected / failed or Pending / inconclusive

decisions.rule: Trace result PDF shows Rejected / failed (status shows Rejected, Failed, Returned, Unpaid, or an ACH return code (e.g., R01–R33) or bank 'beneficiary reject' language)
decisions.then: Comment on OPS-AP-INV with trace outcome summary. Update Jira OPS-AP-INV with FIN-201 Vendor AP Hold. Email the vendor Template A-2.

decisions.rule: Trace result PDF shows Pending / inconclusive (status is Processing, Pending, or ambiguous)
decisions.then: Add Jira comment 'Trace inconclusive — [quote field names/values]' on OPS-AP-INV and do not send Template A-1; escalate per AP queue pinned instructions.

steps: Open Jira issue OPS-AP-INV-[InvoiceNumber].
Read Payment Status and ACH Trace Number fields in the description or custom fields.
If status is Paid: Copy the 12-digit ACH trace number and proceed to Trace funds.

If status is not Paid (Pending, Processing, Approved-Unpaid, Under Review): (a) Do not request a trace yet. (b) Capture status and payment run/date from the Jira description and record them in a Jira comment. (c) Email the vendor using Template A-4 without attaching a clearing confirmation. (d) If the vendor disputes urgency or invoice is past due, Email the AP Lead listed on the AP queue board's pinned issue per §1.3.
If status is failed/rejected: Set Jira label or comment FIN-201 Vendor AP Hold and send Template A-2.
Trace funds (Paid status only): Download the bank trace result PDF from Jira OPS-APTRACE-[TraceNumber] (or use the trace attachment on the invoice issue).

Interpret the PDF: If cleared/successful, download the clearing confirmation PDF from Jira OPS-AP-INV-[InvoiceNumber] first (primary location). If not there, download from OPS-AP-TRACE[TraceNumber]. If neither issue contains the file, comment 'Clearing confirmation missing' on OPS-AP-INV and follow the AP queue's exception path — do not send Template A-1 until the PDF is attached. Email the vendor Template A-1 attaching the PDF.
If payment rejected: Comment on OPS-AP-INV with trace outcome summary. Update Jira OPS-AP-INV with FIN-201 Vendor AP Hold. Email the vendor Template A-2.
If pending/inconclusive: Add Jira comment 'Trace inconclusive — [quote field names/values]' on OPS-AP-INV and do not send Template A-1; escalate per AP queue pinned instructions.
must_not: Do not request a trace if status is not Paid.
Do not send Template A-1 until the clearing confirmation PDF is attached.
Do not send Template A-1 if trace is pending/inconclusive.
notes: Escalate per AP queue pinned instructions for inconclusive traces or missing clearing confirmations.

links.when: Payment cleared and clearing confirmation PDF attached
Payment status not Paid (Pending, Processing, Approved-Unpaid, Under Review)

procedures.name: Auditing High-Risk Wire Transfers
procedures.applies_when: International wire transfers require verification of dual authorization.

inputs.fact: Approver names, exact Approved text, and titles

inputs.source: Compliance-Alerts board's pinned issue per §1.3 Queue Assignee

decisions.rule: Slack search using has:link [Wire ID], in:treasury-wires [Wire ID], or in:treasury-wires "[Wire ID]" returns results
decisions.then: Proceed to check signatories
decisions.else: Record 'Slack search exhausted' for that Wire ID and proceed to Escalation

decisions.rule: Two distinct Approved messages from users with Slack profile Title showing VP, AVP, SVP, EVP, C-level, or higher are confirmed
decisions.then: Update Jira OPS-TRE-WIRE-[WireID] to Verified (or equivalent); no Compliance ticket required

steps: Pull population: From Jira OPS-TRE-WIRES-[Quarter], download the international wires population workbook attached to the issue (Excel as provided).

For each Wire ID, open Slack and search treasury-wires in this order until you locate the approval thread: has:link [Wire ID]; in:treasury-wires [Wire ID]; in:treasury-wires "[Wire ID]" (quoted exact match). Document which query worked in your Excel wire log or Jira OPS-TRE-WIRE comment.
If all three Slack searches return no results, record 'Slack search exhausted' for that Wire ID and proceed to Escalation.

Check signatories: Confirm two distinct Approved messages from users whose Slack profile Title shows VP, AVP, SVP, EVP, C-level, or higher. Record approver names, exact Approved text, and titles in Excel or in a Jira comment on OPS-TRE-WIRE[WireID].

Escalation (missing dual approval): Update Jira OPS-TRE-WIRE-[WireID] with exception code TRE-900. Create Jira Compliance-Alerts with title "Exception Report: International Wire Control Exception – [Wire ID]". Paste Template B-3 into the description; attach your Excel wire row or export. Assign to the Chief Compliance Officer listed on the Compliance-Alerts board's pinned issue per §1.3 Queue Assignee. Immediately after, send Slack Template B-4 to compliance-urgent with the new Compliance-Alerts issue key only — do not post wire amounts or bank details in Slack.

procedures.name: Conducting Premium Variance Audits

Jira OPS-UW-POL-[PolicyNumber] issue attachments (PDF or Excel as provided)

procedures.name: Calculating Multi-State Tax Nexus
procedures.applies_when: Preparing state exposure and tax allocation support for multi-state operations.

inputs.source: Jira OPS-UW-APP-[ApplicationID] or linked underwriting reference issue
Jira OPS-UW-APP-[ApplicationID] or linked policy issue

decisions.rule: If total payroll is not on OPS-UW-APP-[ApplicationID] or on a linked policy issue
decisions.then: Request missing payroll

decisions.rule: If schedule shows payroll by state
decisions.then: State % = State Payroll ÷ Total Payroll

steps: Review application: From Jira OPS-UW-APP-[ApplicationID], download the locations / schedule attachment(s) listed on the issue. Note multiple states if present.

Determine surtaxes: From the same Jira issue (or linked underwriting reference issue named in the description), download the state tax / surtax matrix attachment. Crossreference states from the schedule.

Request missing payroll (if needed): If total payroll is not on OPS-UW-APP[ApplicationID] or on a linked policy issue, add a Jira comment: "Payroll attachment required for multi-state tax allocation — see OPS-UW-TAX-[ApplicationID]." @mention the Assignee or Underwriter field on that issue. Do not continue to the calculation step until payroll is provided via Jira attachment or comment.

Calculate allocation and surtax: In Excel, enter total payroll from the attachment. Allocate by state: (a) if schedule shows payroll by state, State % = State Payroll ÷ Total Payroll; (b) if only locations, State % = (locations in state ÷ total locations). For each state: Allocated Payroll = Total Payroll × State %; State Surtax = Allocated Payroll × rate from matrix (e.g., 1.25% as 0.0125).

Finalize entry: Save the completed allocation workbook using the naming convention stated on OPS-UW-TAX-[ApplicationID] or, if none is stated, per §1.4 (include the application identifier in the filename). Attach it to that issue, and record state tax amounts in the issue description table if provided. Comment "Save Tax Allocation" with date and analyst initials.

No dollar amounts in Slack notice.

procedures.name: Identifying Subrogation Opportunities
procedures.applies_when: Closed, paid (indemnity issued) claims where a police report suggests third-party liability.

inputs.fact: Issue keys from Jira filter CLM-Subro-Triage with Status = ClosedWith-Payment
Agency, report number, report date from police report header
Named drivers, unit numbers, insured party, collision type, signals, fault statements
inputs.source: Police report PDF narrative and supplemental sections

decisions.rule: Police report PDF is attached and readable
decisions.then: Proceed to index and read PDF
decisions.else: Comment 'Subro triage skipped — police report PDF missing' and skip

decisions.rule: Narrative or supplemental sections attribute fault to another party using at least one of: exact phrases 'Citation Issued,' 'At Fault,' or 'Failed to Yield' directed at a non-insured party; or equivalent standardized wording permitted by rubric linked from CLM-SubroTriage
decisions.then: Flag as Positive indicators (third party)
decisions.else: Check for Negative indicators or Ambiguous/shared fault

decisions.rule: Report shows our insured was cited, labeled At Fault, Failed to Yield (insured), or narrative indicates sole insured negligence
decisions.then: Comment 'Subro triage — no third-party fault language' and do not flag
decisions.else: Treat as Ambiguous or shared fault

decisions.rule: Fault is shared, unclear, or heavily redacted
decisions.then: Comment 'Subro triage — ambiguous fault narrative; supervisor review' and create Jira CLM-SUBRO-REVIEW linked to CLM-[number]

decisions.rule: CLM-Subro-Triage filter description contains a current on-call Claims Supervisor name
decisions.then: Assign CLM-SUBRO-REVIEW to that supervisor
decisions.else: Slack claims-ops with: '[Subro Triage] Ambiguous fault — CLM[number] — need on-call supervisor assignment'

steps: Build population: Run saved Jira filter CLM-Subro-Triage limited to Status = ClosedWith-Payment. Optionally export issue keys to a local Excel batching list (name per §1.4). Work issues in ascending claim number unless filter description specifies different priority.

Police report gate: For each CLM-[number], confirm a police report PDF is attached (issue checklist or labels). If missing or unreadable, comment 'Subro triage skipped — police report PDF missing' and skip; do not infer fault from other documents.
Open and index PDF: Download police report PDF. Note agency, report number, and report date from header in a Jira triage comment.
Read narrative and parties: Identify named drivers, unit numbers, and which party represents our insured. Skim for collision type, signals, and any statement of fault.

Positive indicators (third party): Flag subrogation potential only when narrative or supplemental sections attribute fault to another party using at least one of: exact phrases 'Citation Issued,' 'At Fault,' or 'Failed to Yield' directed at a non-insured party; or equivalent standardized wording permitted by rubric linked from CLM-SubroTriage. If equivalents unclear, follow 'Ambiguous or shared fault' — do not treat as meeting Positive indicators.

Negative indicators (no flag): Do not flag if report shows our insured was cited, labeled At Fault, Failed to Yield (insured), or narrative indicates sole insured negligence. Comment 'Subro triage — no third-party fault language.'

Ambiguous or shared fault: If fault is shared, unclear, or heavily redacted, comment 'Subro triage — ambiguous fault narrative; supervisor review.' Create Jira CLM-SUBRO-REVIEW linked to CLM-[number]. Assign to on-call Claims Supervisor listed in CLM-Subro-Triage filter description. If filter description does not contain current on-call name, Slack claims-ops with: '[Subro Triage] Ambiguous fault — CLM[number] — need on-call supervisor assignment.' Do not apply CLM-440 until cleared.

Queue transfer (positive): When Positive indicators are satisfied and neither Negative indicators nor Ambiguous or shared fault applies, comment 'Subro potential: [brief quote or section/page reference]'. Transition 'Assign to Subrogation' or label CLM-440 Subro Potential per workflow.
must_not: Do not infer fault from other documents if police report PDF is missing or unreadable.
Do not treat unclear equivalents as meeting Positive indicators.
Do not apply CLM-440 until ambiguous/shared fault is cleared by supervisor.
notes: Work issues in ascending claim number unless filter description specifies different priority.
Subrogation recovery generally follows payment to the insured; unpaid closures are out of scope.

decisions.else: Stop — do not calculate allocation or route for payout.

steps: Verify documentation: From Jira CLM-LIFE-[number], download the death certificate PDF. Compare name and SSN to insured fields in the Jira issue.
Review beneficiary schedule: Download the original policy (or declarations) PDF attached to the issue; note Primary and Contingent percentage splits.

List Contingent beneficiaries only if no Primary beneficiaries survive.); Analyst: [Initials] | Date: [YYYY-MM-DD].

Do not set CLM-920 if CLM-910 is active; only add note re potential conflict.
Do not calculate allocation or route for payout if CLM-910 is still active.

procedures.name: Evaluating Fraud Risk in Claims
procedures.applies_when: Identifying claim anomalies requiring SIU review.

inputs.fact: Loss type, date of loss, and prior-claim flags

inputs.source: Jira attachments with image extensions (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .tiff) whose label or file name includes the reported date of loss or contains 'current,' 'loss,' or 'scene'
ZIP or prior CLM attachments linked from the claim issue

inputs.fact: Visible timestamps or embedded file dates

inputs.source: PDF attachment on the claim issue

decisions.rule: Duplicate or reuse is documented in Historical comparison, OR Inspector notes contain any keyword hit (Inconsistent, Pre-existing, Wear and tear, Prior damage, Unrelated), OR Metadata sanity check shows a date inconsistency that undermines loss timing
decisions.then: Apply SIU hold and referral
decisions.else: Comment 'SIU prep — no automated SIU triggers; resume standard handling.'

steps: Triage intake: Open Jira CLM-PROP-[number] from the SIU prep queue or supervisor assignment. Read loss type, date of loss, and any prior-claim flags in the description. If status is already CLM-999, confirm whether you are documenting supplemental findings only.

Photo inventory: Download current-loss images from Jira attachments. Current-loss images are defined as files with image extensions (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .tiff) whose Jira attachment label or file name includes the reported date of loss or contains the word 'current,' 'loss,' or 'scene.' Exclude PDF documents, spreadsheets, and any image file whose name or label references a prior claim number. Comment 'Photo inventory complete — [n] image files' with the list of file names.

Historical comparison: Use the historical photo package linked from the claim issue (ZIP or prior CLM attachments). Identical match (binary): same file as a prior attachment (matching file name and size, or checksum if provided in Jira), or documentation in Jira explicitly states the file is a re-upload from a prior claim. Same-angle match (stricter — use only when all are true; otherwise do not use this label): (i) prior and current issues share the same loss location address in Jira; (ii) the same architectural feature or vehicle body panel clearly occupies the majority of both frames; (iii) at least two fixed reference points appear in the same left-to-right order and within 15% of frame width of each other's positions. If you cannot verify (ii) and (iii) without guesswork, do not call it a same-angle match — comment 'Possible visual similarity — needs manual review.' Document confirmed pairs as 'Current [file] matches Prior CLM-[id] [file/date] — [Identical | Same-angle per criteria]' in Jira.

Metadata sanity check: If visible timestamps or embedded file dates contradict the reported date of loss, note 'Date metadata inconsistency' in an internal Jira comment (no accusatory language in customer-visible fields).

Inspector notes: Download the field inspector notes PDF from the claim issue attachments. Search for: Inconsistent, Pre-existing, Wear and tear, Prior damage, Unrelated. Copy exact wording into an internal Jira comment (SIU prep — inspector quotes).

Decision matrix: Apply SIU hold and referral if (a) duplicate or reuse is documented in Historical comparison, OR (b) Inspector notes contain any keyword hit from that step, OR (c) Metadata sanity check shows a date inconsistency that undermines loss timing. If none apply, comment 'SIU prep — no automated SIU triggers; resume standard handling.'
SIU hold: When the Decision matrix above applies, set CLM-999 SIU Hold. Do not discuss fraud theories with the insured in the same thread as SIU comments.

Refer to SIU: In Word, paste Memo Template D-2; save the referral memo per §1.4 (include claim number in the filename); attach to Jira SIU-INTAKE-[ClaimNumber]. On CLM-[number], comment only 'SIU referral filed — see SIU-[key]'.
must_not: Do not use same-angle match label unless all three criteria are true.
Do not call it a same-angle match if you cannot verify (ii) and (iii) without guesswork.
Do not use accusatory language in customer-visible fields when noting date metadata inconsistency.
Do not discuss fraud theories with the insured in the same thread as SIU comments.
